crystalmod.market_block.help_text:
Listings can only be created in-game: put an item in the terminal slot and set a price per unit.

All item data - enchantments, backpack/shulker box contents, etc. - is preserved and delivered to the buyer without loss.

The price is always per unit. In the catalog, next to "Buy", there's a "Qty" field for how many units to buy at once (capped by what's left in the listing).

You can cancel your own listing from "My listings" - any unsold remainder is returned to you.
